text:
elaine: Deploy window in 5m (change window 10:00 PT). Rolling out assistant-core v7.0.0. Feature flag `ff_context_affinity` will be enabled 10% -> 40% -> 100% with 8m holds. We'll pin model routing to prod-v3.4 for 1h as a safety. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v7.0.0. any concerns?

deploy-bot: Scheduled start: 2025-01-12T10:00:00PT. Canary batch = 8. Plan: 10% @t+2m, 40% @t+10m, 100% @t+26m. Auto-pause rules: p99>230ms for 5m OR 5xx>0.4% for 4m OR model-affinity-drift > 12% over 6m. Will post step results.

mike: I'll own SLOs and affinity drift metric. Add a safety action: if affinity drift crosses threshold, pause and pin routing + increase trace sampling.

sophie: Docs request: include the model-pin note in release notes and the quick rollback snippet. Also note expected token-cost change (+~5%).

infra-sre: I'll monitor infra and routing. @deploy-bot please expose an operator rollback one-liner in-thread. Confirm who has deploy token.

deploy-bot: Operator rollback snippet:
```
# rollback flag and pin routing
redwoodctl ff set ff_context_affinity 0 --reason "rollback: affinity drift"
redwoodctl routing pin model prod-v3.4 --duration 60m
# optional: revert canary pods to previous image
kubectl set image deployment/assistant-core assistant-core=assistant-core:v6.9.9 -n prod
```

elaine: Runbook: pause -> attach top10 traces -> notify #incidents -> decision within 12m. If affinity drift, we pin routing and roll back.

deploy-bot: Canary at 10% stable @t+4m. Moving to 40% now.

mike: Affinity drift metric shows +9% at t+9m, below pause. p95 spike at t+11m but short. Holding.

deploy-bot: Reached 40% @t+12m. Increasing trace sampling for error traces.

infra-sre: Not seeing infra pressure. Cache hit stable.

mike: At t+18m affinity drift crossed 13% over 6m window -> automated pause triggered. Ramp paused at 40%.

elaine: Confirmed. Executing runbook: pause, collecting top traces, tagging @release-manager and infra-sre.

sophie: Posting a short note to product: "pause at 40% due to model-affinity drift; investigating".

infra-sre: Quick dig shows a routing flapper between two clusters that increased cold-starts and caused the apparent drift. Not a model change. We recommend fixing routing and then resuming ramp.

mike: Agree. Let's fix routing, validate affinity metric returns below 8%, then resume with smaller tail: 40% -> 65% -> 85% -> 100% with 6m holds. Keep model pinned for 60m.

deploy-bot: Routing fix applied at t+39m. Affinity drift down to 4% by t+44m. Resuming ramp with adjusted steps.

elaine: Proceeding with adjusted ramp. Thanks infra. Leaving thread open for 60m post-unpin. :white_check_mark:
